text: Three Filipino tales share one dread. In an abandoned house, three teenagers [play spirit of the glass|origin|deliberately called up] and are possessed by lovers from a Spanish colonial feud; a mother and daughter move into a new home where [an old refrigerator kills and stores the dead|images|household objects and machines]; and in the forest at Holy Week, young Douglas serenades Anita, whom his grandmother suspects is [a manananggal, the vampiric creature|threat|blood drinkers] behind the local murders.
